Nat Geo Animal's Bite Sting Kill explores the science and survival tactics of the planet's most venmous and lethal predators. In this mashup episode, the team explores the dangerous wildlife that call the dunes of the hot desert home. From eight-legged venomous killers to the surprising mammals that have no mercy on their victims, it's a dangerous world down in the desert dunes.
